title: Admin toolchain almanac and telemetry: registry for operator utilities
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a centralized 'almanac' and registry for admin utilities and runflow artifacts that standardizes metadata, telemetry events, and execution fingerprints. The almanac will be the canonical source for: operator micro-utilities, idempotent playlets, safe parameter schemas, recommended RBAC scopes, audit logging expectations, replay/dry-run flags, and links to docs/PRs. This aims to reduce cognitive load for oncall engineers, speed up remediation, and make synthetic/automated remediation safer and observable.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical JSON schema for utility metadata published and documented in Confluence
Registry service implemented with read/write API and per-utility versioning
Telemetry spec (event types, severity, task_latency_ms, success/failure, replayed boolean) agreed and instrumented in agent SDK
Integration demos: 2 existing runlets converted to reference metadata and passed end-to-end dry-run and canary execution
Runbook console surface shows tool provenance, last-modified, and associated GH PRs or Confluence pages
design_notes: Prefer lightweight registry (DynamoDB + small API) over monolithic DB to keep operational footprint small. Store immutable versions for each utility artifact; allow tags for 'canary'/'stable'. Schema will include: idempotency_token_format, required_secrets, minimum_safety_checks, recommended_batching_hint, kv-cache-impact-note, expected_token_cost_estimate. We debated embedding policy enforcement in registry vs relying on client SDKs; outcome: keep enforcement in SDKs for flexibility and allow registry to expose policy hints.
implementation_plan: 1) Draft metadata schema and telemetry spec in Confluence (Aisha) 2) Build registry API service skeleton and auth (Marco) 3) Implement SDK helpers to read metadata and emit telemetry (Samira) 4) Migrate two pilot utilities (repairlet-ssh-cleanup, db-conn-reset) 5) Run canary: dry-run followed by staged enablement behind feature flag 6) Roll out to ops console and bake dashboards
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Registry becomes a single point of confusion if schemas are inconsistent — Mitigation: strong validation on write and CI checks on PRs that update metadata
Risk: Telemetry volume spike from synthetic playlets — Mitigation: sample dry-runs and add adaptive sampling in SDK
Risk: Unsafe automated remediation from poorly authored utilities — Mitigation: require 'safety_review' metadata flag and manual approval gate before auto-run access
